adjudication.rationale: In the new API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler calls `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` without a try/catch. Zod’s `parse` throws on invalid input, which will bubble up and produce an unhandled 500 in a Next.js API route. Similarly, `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` is not guarded; if decryption fails or returns non-JSON, `JSON.parse` will throw and again result in a 500. This contradicts the handler’s otherwise explicit 4xx responses for client errors (e.g., invalid secret, missing user/app) and would log stack traces for malformed/invalid webhook requests.
